item.title: TalentCLEF 2026 Workshop Schedule
item.description: Info. This is a preliminary schedule. Times, talks and speakers are subject to change until the final CLEF 2026 programme is published. The presentations will not necessarily be given in the order shown below, so we kindly ask all participants to attend the full session in which their talk is scheduled. Tuesday 22 September 14:00-15:30 Session 1 Welcome to TalentCLEF 2026 Organizers (Luis Gascó) Overview of TalentCLEF 2026: Task A — Contextualized Job–Person Matching
